members.name: suggestion
doc: Set only under Everything: the selection the typed line looks like it is for (planLine), or null

members.name: onExample
doc: Called when someone taps an example line

members.name: onRunFinder
members.type: (labels: { deptName: string | null; gradeName: string | null }) => void

members.name: utilitiesOpen
doc: True while the Utility Services page is open

members.name: onUtilities
doc: Called on a tap of the Utility Services button: I open the page of all the utilities.

members.name: notice
doc: A sentence I show under the choices (EDS asked by a signed-in person who is not an executive)

members.name: edsReady
doc: True when the person may use Executive Deep Search (a signed-in executive). Only then do I show its hint and example questions; for anyone else the prompt or the notice stands alone.

members.name: adminReady
doc: True once a signed-in person has pressed Admin: only then may the hint and the examples show (before that, the prompt asks who is asking).

members.name: onAdminHint
doc: Called when the Admin button is pointed at, touched or focused: I fetch the management page ahead, so pressing it shows the page at once.

symbols.name: RecordsScopeBar
symbols.sig: export function RecordsScopeBar({ selection, onChange, suggestion, onExample, onRunFinder, utilitiesOpen, onUtilities, notice, edsReady, adminReady, onAdminHint }: RecordsScopeBarProps)

params.name: { selection, onChange, suggestion, onExample, onRunFinder, utilitiesOpen, onUtilities, notice, edsReady, adminReady, onAdminHint }

behaviours: two rows: the records' radio group named 'Search in' (Everything and six records) and, on their own row, titled 'More tools' (Utility Services, Executive Deep Search and Admin)
the chips, in order: Everything, People, PAX, Hospital OPD, Holidays, Degrees, Circulars & Notices, then (More tools) Executive Deep Search and Admin
the Utility Services button opens its page and is marked while the page is open; EDS is the choice that is not a record, with its own words
Everything is the chosen one at the start, and nothing else is
under Everything there is no hint, no examples, no finder, no People facets
no suggestion unless the typed line earns one
EDS chosen: it alone is checked, its hint is shown, no example buttons (the questions to try are the shelf in the window, src/components/EdsExamples.tsx), no records hint

EDS chosen by someone who may not use it (a visitor, or a signed-in non-executive): only the prompt or the notice stands, NOT the hint and the example questions (the words would repeat the prompt's first line)
a notice (EDS asked by a signed-in person who is not an executive) is announced as a status; none otherwise
the address of an EDS question carries no selection (it travels as mode=intellectual)
a suggestion marks that chip and says so in words, without choosing it
a chosen selection is the only checked chip, shows its hint and tap-to-fill examples
a suggestion is never shown once a selection is chosen
People shows its three ways to look, the first chosen, with its hint and examples
Department & designation shows the finder (two lists, a name box, a button) and no examples
the finder's button is disabled until something is picked or typed, then enabled
the other facet has no finder
the bar is drawn under the box, with the selection, a way to change it, the planner's suggestion (only under Everything), the examples and the finder's button
Enter: a calculator or other tool line still returns first; then a chosen selection is answered by its own engines; only then the ID, management and guessing paths
Circulars & Notices keep the ordinary path minus the people name search and the AI that guesses a utility
Enter under EDS goes to runEds (an executive straight to the deep synthesis, a visitor asked 'Are you an executive?', a signed-in non-executive told so), before the other selections
the Utility Services button clears the box and any answer and opens the page of all the utilities
choosing another choice WIPES the words in the box
EDS pressed: a visitor is asked 'Are you an executive?' at once (Yes: opens the login window; No: back to Everything), a signed-in non-executive is told, an executive just gets the box
...and a visitor who signs in as an executive after pressing the button has the card taken away (nothing waits to resume)

the Utility Services page stands ALONE: the box, the choices and what hangs under them are left out while it is open (and while a calculator opened from it is), it ends when the page is closed, and Escape goes back to the ordinary window
the top bar's own Escape (which closes the whole search window) stands aside while the page is alone: the modal marks itself with data-escape-back and the top bar returns early when it finds the mark
the Utility Services page has a Back button (to the search) at its top right, not a cross
the Utility Services button turns the page-alone state on
People > Department & designation: Enter in the main box does nothing (the lists and their button run it)
choosing another selection leaves nothing of the old one (results, search, utility, question) and the selection is part of the live number lookup's condition
the finder labels the box with its own words and asks the server once with the selection in the address
the as-you-type guesses (a utility, a name) and the Enter-time utility guess are off under every chosen selection, Circulars & Notices included
intranet-site links are shown beside the answers of Everything only
the selection is part of every search address (so an answer under one selection is never shown under another) and every opening starts on Everything
the route reads the selection from the address only, validated (anything unknown is Everything), and answers a chosen one before the name checks and the model router
under Circulars & Notices no person, department or router is consulted
a chosen selection that finds nothing never reaches the circular search (the scoped answer is returned, whatever it is)
Admin sits in More tools after Executive Deep Search, with the label 'Admin'
Admin chosen: it alone is checked; its hint and examples show once a signed-in person has pressed it
Admin chosen by a visitor: only the question stands (no hint, no examples, the words would repeat it)
